, in dwarf goats treated with PB or TAO, P450 3As and 2Bs were induced at both the mRNA and protein levels.
, in goats, PB, TAO and BNF induce P450 3As, P450 1As and P450 2Bs, respectively.
, in dwarf goats: 1) PB and TAO induce P450 3As and 2Bs; 2) BNF induces P450 1As, but does not induce P450 2Bs; and 3) the P450 2C form is not inducible.

in dwarf goats, PB and TAO are P450 3As inducers and that BNF induces a P450 1 form.
